tool.name: comprehensive_asset_valuator
tool.description: Advanced real-time asset valuation tool with AI-powered market analysis. Provides instant valuation for precious metals, cryptocurrencies, and other assets using live market data and predictive analytics. Features include historical price trends, volatility analysis, and future price projections. Requires authentication for premium features.
